label: AMS demo boundary
query: Why is the Kyriba Source event safe to demo as full-spine while the AMS event is not?
answer:
My read: For Lakeshore Holdings, Kyriba is demo-safe as a “full-spine” Source event because its artifact trail and approvals are actually in place through BAFO, while the AMS modernization event only has credible evidence through Evaluation and is missing the downstream artifacts and approvals that would make a full-spine story honest. Why: Kyriba (LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026) has a full artifact spine with Strategy through BAFO explicitly approved. That means the business case, options analysis, sponsor gates, and selection recommendation are documented and have real approval owners. You can safely walk a CFO/CIO through “from strategy to BAFO” with stored evidence behind each step. For AMS (LSH-AMS-MODERNIZATION-2026), the loaded data is only safe through Evaluation. Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value are still review/needs-review demo states. Presenting AMS as BAFO, Decision, or Transition-complete would imply sponsor gates, SLAs, operating model, and service-credit/governance terms that are not actually evidenced. The setup/admin approval-ledger proof is not complete overall, so Kyriba is the only event where the Source artifact chain is strong enough to withstand scrutiny as a “full spine.”

Decision fork: If you need to show “how Source works end-to-end,” use Kyriba and be explicit that AMS is still in Evaluation. If you want to talk about AMS, frame it as “live through Evaluation, hypothetical beyond,” not as a completed selection or transition.
